adaptation: Named placeholders replace Python format slots. Rendered prompt wording is preserved. Exact yes/no parsing replaces substring matching. The Gateway judge uses an explicitly unpinned GPT-4o alias and its required minimum 16-token output bound rather than the native 10-token bound, so its scores are not exact reproductions of the native pinned judge stack.
